+from hydra.utils import instantiate
+
+def fn():
+    return "fn return"
+
+class A:
+    def __init__(self):
+        print("in A.__init__")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def method(cls):
+        return "A.method return"
+
+    class B:
+        def __init__(self):
+            print("in A.B.__init__")
+
+print("Testing fn...")
+fn_return = instantiate({}, _target_=fn)
+print(f"fn_return: {fn_return}")
+
+print("\nTesting A...")
+A_instance = instantiate({}, _target_=A)
+print("A_instance created")
+
+print("\nTesting A.method...")
+A_method_return = instantiate({}, _target_=A.method)
+print(f"A_method_return: {A_method_return}")
+
+print("\nTesting A.B...")
+try:
+    A_B_instance = instantiate({}, _target_=A.B)
+    print("A_B_instance created")
+except Exception as e:
+    print(f"Caught exception: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
+    import traceback
+    traceback.print_exc()
